newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish cotton production hit by bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Turkish cotton production hit by bad weather.

text.p: Bad weather has adversely affected cotton production in the Aegean region of western Turkey, a trade official said on Wednesday.
The state must take measures quickly to offset the negative impact of unseasonally cold weather, according to Sadi Katircioglu, deputy chairman of the Izmir Trade Bourse.
"The time to create a state policy (on helping the farmers) has already come and gone," he said, calling for the state to support farmers with limited financial means.
He told Reuters farmers had been unable to sow cotton at the right time.
"Our chance of competing in foreign markets will decline...because of the weakness of our cotton production," he said.

"The fall in our cotton production is not just a problem for producers. Turkey has made big investments in textiles. If it cannot comfortably assure the raw materials, textile producers and clothes manufacturers may face big problems in the coming year," he said.
